Save this list of 20 famous tourist attractions in Binh Thuan and start planning your journey to explore this stunning coastal destination. These places promise unforgettable experiences and are perfect for travelers who love nature, culture, and adventure.

Located in Vietnam’s South Central Coast region, Binh Thuan is a true paradise for travel enthusiasts. The province captivates visitors with its turquoise seas, white sand beaches, golden sunshine, and unique cultural landmarks. So, what makes a Binh Thuan tour so special? Let’s explore the top attractions below with Vietlook Travel.

Top 20 Stunning Tourist Attractions In Binh Thuan

Binh Thuan is not only famous for its breathtaking landscapes but also for producing Vietnam’s iconic fish sauce. The following 20 destinations will surely enrich your upcoming journey with memorable experiences.

1. Phu Quy Island

Recently rising as a travel hotspot, Phu Quy Island attracts visitors with its untouched beauty. Located in the middle of the East Sea, the island features dramatic coastal scenery and resembles a dragon resting on the waves when viewed from afar. It is an ideal destination for travelers seeking tranquility, romance, and a deep connection with nature.

Location: Approximately 56 nautical miles from Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

2. Cu Lao Cau Island

Cu Lao Cau is a remote and relatively undiscovered island, about 1.5 hours by boat from the mainland. Due to limited tourism development, the island retains its pristine and unspoiled charm. Crystal-clear waters and peaceful surroundings make it one of the most beautiful hidden gems in Binh Thuan.

Location: Phuoc The Commune, Tuy Phong District, Binh Thuan Province

3. Ta Cu Mountain

One of Binh Thuan’s most famous attractions, Ta Cu Mountain boasts majestic natural scenery. From the summit, visitors can enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding landscape and breathe in fresh mountain air. A clear stream flowing across the mountain keeps the climate cool year-round, making it a great destination at any time.

Location: Thuan Nam Town, Ham Thuan Nam District, Binh Thuan Province

4. Co Thach Beach

Co Thach Beach is well known for its emerald waters, gentle waves, and colorful rock formations. In March, the rocks are covered with green moss, creating a spectacular natural scene that attracts photographers and nature lovers alike.

Location: Binh Thanh Commune, Tuy Phong District, Binh Thuan Province

5. Ke Ga Cape

Also known as Khe Ga Cape, this coastal landmark extends into the East Sea and lies about 500 meters from the mainland. During low tide, a sandy path appears, connecting the shore to the cape—an impressive natural phenomenon.

Location: Tan Thanh Commune, Ham Thuan Nam District, Binh Thuan Province

6. Red Sand Dunes

Located about 25 kilometers from Phan Thiet City, the Red Sand Dunes are famous for their golden-red hue and constantly shifting shapes. This ever-changing landscape makes it one of the most photographed attractions in Binh Thuan.

Location: Hon Rom Area, Mui Ne, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

7. Bien Lac Lake

Bien Lac Lake is an ideal picnic and eco-tourism destination surrounded by primeval forests and rubber plantations. Visitors can enjoy boating, fishing, and grilling fresh catches while immersing themselves in the area’s rich biodiversity.

Location: Tanh Linh District and part of Duc Linh District, Binh Thuan Province

8. Ong Dia Rock Beach

Known for its clear water and large rock formations extending into the sea, Ong Dia Rock Beach holds both scenic and cultural significance for local residents. It is a popular stop for sightseeing and photography.

Location: Nguyen Dinh Chieu Street, Phu Hai Ward, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

9. Mui Ne Fishing Village

Mui Ne Fishing Village offers a vibrant glimpse into local life. Early mornings are especially lively, with fishermen trading fresh seafood such as crabs and squid. It is a great place to experience authentic coastal culture.

Location: 321 Huynh Thuc Khang Street, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

10. Po Sah Inu Cham Towers

Also known as Pho Hai Cham Towers, this ancient complex showcases the distinctive architecture of the Cham civilization. It is a culturally significant site and a popular attraction for history lovers.

Location: Phu Hai Ward, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

11. Cam Binh Beach

Nestled beneath rows of casuarina trees, Cam Binh Beach offers a breezy, relaxing atmosphere ideal for outdoor activities and seaside relaxation.

Location: Cam Binh Hamlet, Tan Phuoc Commune, La Gi Town, Binh Thuan Province

12. Rang Beach

Rang Beach is renowned for its picturesque coastline, fishing boats, and peaceful ambiance. Walking along the shore while listening to gentle waves is a uniquely soothing experience.

Location: 15 Huynh Thuc Khang Street, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

13. Sand Sculpture Park

This large-scale Sand Sculpture Park features impressive artworks and is a favorite destination for both families and young travelers.

Location: Nguyen Thong Street, Phu Hai Ward, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

14. Hang Pagoda (Co Thach Pagoda)

With over 100 years of history, Hang Pagoda is an important spiritual and cultural site, often described as a living museum of Binh Thuan’s heritage.

Location: Binh Thanh Commune, Tuy Phong District, Binh Thuan Province

15. Ham Thuan Lake

A large hydropower reservoir, Ham Thuan Lake charms visitors with its peaceful, untouched scenery. Boating and photography are popular activities here.

Location: Da Mi Commune, Ham Thuan Bac District, Binh Thuan Province

16. Hon Rom

Though not an island, Hon Rom is a small mountain extending into the sea, known for its tranquil beauty and water sports such as swimming, paragliding, and water slides.

Location: Long Son Hamlet, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

17. Fairy Stream (Suoi Tien)

Fairy Stream is a shallow stream flowing behind red sand dunes for about one kilometer before reaching the sea. Its cool water and poetic scenery make it a must-visit attraction.

Location: Ham Tien Ward, Phan Thiet City, Binh Thuan Province

18. Hon Ba Island

Covering approximately 2.8 hectares, Hon Ba Island resembles a giant turtle emerging from the sea. Its unique shape and surrounding sandbanks create a striking natural scene.

Location: Ham Tan District, Binh Thuan Province

19. Thay Thim Temple

Thay Thim Temple is a spiritual destination known for its distinctive architecture and cultural importance. Many visitors come here to worship and admire its tranquil surroundings.

Location: Tan Tien Commune, La Gi Town, Binh Thuan Province

20. Ke Ga Lighthouse

The Ke Ga Lighthouse is the tallest and oldest lighthouse in Vietnam. Featuring spiral staircases and historic architecture, it is one of Binh Thuan’s most iconic landmarks.

Location: Ke Ga Cape, Ham Thuan Nam District, Binh Thuan Province

Final Thoughts

Above is a complete guide to 20 must-visit attractions in Binh Thuan that no traveler should miss. Whether you love beaches, islands, mountains, or cultural landmarks, Binh Thuan offers something truly special for every journey.
